title: ATS Jobs Openings Scraper – 10 ATS Platforms, One Schema
description: Live jobs from 10 ATS platforms — Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Recruitee, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Workday, Teamtailor, Personio and Breezy — in one schema. Department, team, city/region/country and salary parsed where the ATS exposes it. Filter before you pay.
seoTitle: Hiring Page Scraper, Hiring Data Feed, Pay Range Data
seoDescription: An ATS and applicant tracking system API: job openings data, employment data API, recruiting data API, recruitment data API, open roles API, hiring trends data, and jobs data feed exports.

job.eventDescription: One normalized job posting returned to the dataset.
